reason: The first hand-constructed SVG candidate masters were rejected because they introduced creative shape and color drift from the approved AI-generated references.

source_of_truth.principle: Approved raster references are authoritative until clean traced/vector masters are explicitly approved.
not_authoritative: approximate fonts used as final wordmark

removed_candidate_files.reason: Too creative; shape did not faithfully match the source reference.
Too creative; lockup and wordmark did not faithfully match the source reference.
Too creative; lockup and colors did not faithfully match the source reference.

required_workflow.name: select_reference
required_workflow.requirement: Select the exact source image for the symbol or lockup being vectorized.

required_workflow.name: crop_reference
required_workflow.requirement: Crop the exact symbol/lockup area from the source without altering shape or color.

required_workflow.name: sample_colors
required_workflow.requirement: Sample gold, dark and paper tones from the source reference before defining candidate colors.

required_workflow.name: trace_shape
required_workflow.requirement: Trace or manually vectorize against the visible source outline, not from memory or a descriptive prompt.

required_workflow.name: human_review
required_workflow.requirement: Promote only after explicit human approval based on fidelity.

acceptance_checks.shape_fidelity: The vector candidate must match the source silhouette and internal details closely.
acceptance_checks.color_fidelity: The candidate colors must be sampled or explicitly approved; no invented substitute palette.
acceptance_checks.wordmark_fidelity: The wordmark must be traced/converted from the reference or clearly marked as temporary approximation.
acceptance_checks.texture_handling: Texture may be preserved as presentation reference only; the production master must be clean and flat unless explicitly approved otherwise.
acceptance_checks.comparison_required: No future SVG candidate PR should be accepted without visual comparison evidence.

next_step: Prepare a reference extraction pass before creating another SVG candidate.
